ttfbUnder100Ms.note: Loopback does not reproduce internet/edge latency or cold serverless functions; dynamic API distribution is reported separately.

inpUnder100Ms.note: One scripted cookie rejection per run is not field INP. Zero means no qualifying >=16ms EventTiming entry, not zero interaction cost.

lighthouseMobile100.note: Local simulated mobile score, not a promise for all devices or production.

initialJavaScriptBelow100KB.encodingNote: gzip level 9 / Brotli quality 11 sizes are computed from decoded source; they are potential CDN transfer sizes, not claims about deployed encoding.

externalBlockingCss.note: Inline critical CSS and the small theme script remain. Zero external stylesheet requests does not mean zero CSS bytes or no parser work.

privatePrefetchBeforeAfter.measure: Identical cold-context synthetic desktop dashboard plus3historycycles; estimates from gzip of decoded scripts, wire bytes separately retained in raw evidence; concurrent QA means no quiet timing conclusions.
privatePrefetchBeforeAfter.rawAfterStressStatus: Raw Playwright stress retains1WebKit access-control diagnostic; no claim of zero raw errors. Separate independent causal evidence confirms WebKit console-adapter promotion for caught fetches during document teardown, with real DOM sentinel controls.
